findings_addressed.oracle: Plants a ctypes heap buffer (always PAGE_READWRITE + MEM_PRIVATE on Windows) in the current process. Locates the MemoryRegion covering the buffer address. Asserts SPECIFIC values: protection == 'rw-' (not membership in valid set) and type == 'private' (not membership in valid set). These exact values are derived independently from Windows memory semantics: ctypes.create_string_buffer allocates from the process heap which Windows always marks PAGE_READWRITE (-> 'rw-' via _append_committed_region prot_map) and MEM_PRIVATE (-> 'private' via the MEM_PRIVATE_FLAG branch).
findings_addressed.documented_mutation_protection: Clear prot_map dict in X64DbgBridge._append_committed_region so every region falls through to the default '???' sentinel. Old test accepted '???' (it was in _VALID_PROTECTION_STRINGS). New test fails because '???' != 'rw-'.
findings_addressed.documented_mutation_type: Change `elif mem_type_raw == MEM_PRIVATE_FLAG:` to `elif mem_type_raw == 0:` in X64DbgBridge._append_committed_region so heap regions fall through to region_type = 'unknown'. Old test accepted 'unknown' (it was in _VALID_REGION_TYPES). New test fails because 'unknown' != 'private'.
